steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss and it closed.
Footer with EN language button visible.

steps.text: Does the "EN" language selector have exactly 15 options: English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Português, Italiano, Türkçe, 한국어, 日本語, 繁體中文, 简体中文, Русский, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt, ไทย (read the options, do not choose one)?
steps.saw: Read the options from the page (select elements, not opened). Each of the 2 select elements in the page lists exactly 15 options in this order: English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Português, Italiano, Türkçe, 한국어, 日本語, 繁體中文, 简体中文, Русский, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt, ไทย.
